title: Tape Dropout Specifications for 1-in Types B and C Video Tape Recorders / Reproducers
scope: 1.1 This practice defines the parameters for tape dropouts encountered in the reproduced FM signal of 1-in types B and C video magnetic recorders/reproducers. 1.2 This practice is intended as an aid in the evaluation of dropout characteristics of magnetic tape, not as a specification for recorder/reproducer setup.
